frameworks.name: comparative_advantage
frameworks.notes: France's drone hardware RCA is WEAK vs DJI (China ~global dominance). France's comparative advantage is in services, subsystems (Thales, Safran optics), and regulation-friendly European platforms (Delair, Parrot, Elistair). Score must reflect that France is not the low-opportunity-cost producer of commodity drones.

frameworks.name: gravity
frameworks.notes: Drone-services trade is weakly captured by customs data; gravity via GDP and distance still proxies market size (agriculture, inspection, medical logistics).

products.name: commercial_drones
products.notes: Unmanned aircraft (HS 8806, introduced 2022). French platforms: Delair UX11 (fixed-wing mapping), Parrot ANAFI, Elistair (tethered). Best framed as drone-based services + hardware for inspection/agriculture, not consumer drones.

countries.name: Kenya
countries.notes: Active drone regulation (Kenya Civil Aviation Authority), agriculture and conservation use cases, drone corridors; reverse-engineered Aerostar heritage suggests openness to non-Chinese suppliers.

countries.name: Senegal
countries.notes: Francophone; Zipline-style medical logistics precedent in region; French language advantage for training and services.

countries.name: Morocco
countries.notes: Large agriculture sector (phosphate farming scale), French commercial ties deep; NOTE Morocco also buys military drones — civil/military line is blurry here.
